findings.problem: Directory create/write checks alone do not prove effective permission for each installation/app rename before stopping services.
findings.required_behavior: Read-only pre-stop access checks cover creation in the actual destination root/parent and DELETE on the source object or FILE_DELETE_CHILD on its parent, as required by each real rename.

findings.problem: Build 17763 alone can misidentify Windows Server 2019 as the target Windows 10 Enterprise LTSC 2019 client.
findings.required_behavior: Require ProductType 1, OperatingSystemSKU 125 or 126, build 17763, Windows version 10.0, PowerShell 5.1, and 64-bit host/process for the target classifier.
